content.short: Hallucinogenics is a psychedelic-themed CNFT micro-series.
content.description: Hallucinogenics is a psychedelic-themed NFT micro-series based on the Cardano blockchain. The first series of 108 NFTs is dedicated to DMT Machine Elves, as a tribute to Terrence McKenna, an American ethnobotanist and mystic, who advocated the responsible use of naturally occurring psychedelic plants. He was the first person who used the term "Machine Elves". The next series will be also related to some famous people or topics from the world of psychedelics and hallucinogenic plants that were used for thousands of years in traditional medicines.
content.meta: Find out about Hallucinogenics (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
